# LinkedIn Headline Examples: 1000+ Examples and Recruiter Insights [Updated for 2026]

Most LinkedIn profiles use surprisingly weak headlines that don't strike a good first impression, nor drive clicks to your profile. That's why we've spoken to 15 LinkedIn experts and recruiters to put together 1000+ headlines across industries. Optimized for 2026's LinkedIn algorithms.
